sentences.text:
Respondent :- State Of Up And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Gaurav Dwivedi,Pankaj Dubey,Ram Prakash Dwivedi

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arvind Singh Sangwan,J.
Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.
1.

The instant writ petition has been filed with a prayer to quash the First Information Report dated
07.03.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 15 of 2024 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 377 of Ipc
and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act at Police Station - Mahila Thana, District - Kanpur Nagar
(East).
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that he does not press the present petition qua petitioner No.5, Sahil Chaudhary, husband of the informant.
Therefore, petition qua petitioner No.5 is dismissed as withdrawn.
3. Counsel further submits that petitioner nos. 1 to 4 are family members of husband of informant- respondent no. 4.

He also submitted that petitioner no. 1 is mother-in-law of the informant, who is Smt Madhu Chaudhary And 4 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41908354/
1 suffering from ailment and there is no allegation of demand of dowry.

sentences.text: 4. Be that as it may, the writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the respondent no. 2 that no coercive action be taken against the petitioner nos. 1 to 4 pursuant to the aforesaid F.I.R.

However,
it will be open to the Investigating Officer to proceed against petitioner No.5 in accordance with law.
